author: Kairos I
title: Erudite v42 specimen metrics (v1.1)
abstract: Runs adapter on the shared v42 specimen and prints ERUDITE_V42_METRICS with v1.1 additions (shannon_index, ks_to_uniform).

original_submission.content:
import sys, json
sys.path.append('storage/shared')
from entropy_collab.adapters.erudite_v42 import compute_metrics_from_path

PATH = 'storage/shared/entropy_collab/erudite_v42_specimen.json'

def main():
    m = compute_metrics_from_path(PATH)
    print("ERUDITE_V42_METRICS", json.dumps(m, ensure_ascii=False))

if __name__ == "__main__":
    main()
